System Response: the engineer's path

Today one screen holds three columns: the event list, the event's analysis and the loop's model history, with the result, steps and quantities said twice. Proposed: one band to choose the loop and the event, and six tabs, one question each.

Every tabLoop search ▾Event ▾ (accepted, newest first; censored on request)‹ ›… Workbench ↗ · Open loop ↗

Events

Which steps did the loop see, and which qualified?
  • Events, accepted, model state: the three counts once
  • The events as a table: time, type, path, state, finding, model
  • Censored rows on request

Response

What model came out of this step?
  • The result: model, K, θ ±, τ, validation
  • The response chart, full width: PV, fit, band, input
  • The reported quantities only

Fit quality

Can the model be trusted?
  • Residuals and their autocorrelation, side by side
  • Candidate models, ranked, with why each was kept or rejected
  • The delay objective (flat = delay not identifiable)

Frequency

How much margin does the loop have?
  • Magnitude and phase, side by side
  • Gain and phase margins, crossover
  • One line when not claimed, and why

Steps & data

How did the kernel decide?
  • Steps A–H as cards, outputs on demand
  • The event's window, method, run, bundle
  • All 52 quantities, reported first

Models

How has the loop's model changed, and is it reviewed?
  • Gain, dead time, time constant: three trends side by side
  • The models table, Export CSV
  • Review (cpm.model.review)

What goes

The three-column layoutEach tab uses the full width; the response chart doubles in width
K, θ, τ said twiceOnce, in the Response result; the full list on Steps & data
Four "nothing to draw" panelsOne note per tab when the arrays were not kept, with the way to reconstruct them
16 key results, most "not applicable"The reported ones on Response; all 52 on Steps & data, reported first
Header ? and the site-zone sentenceRemoved; the zone is named on the times
The tiles above the columnsOn Events only

What stays exactly

Every chart and tableResponse, residuals, autocorrelation, candidates, delay curve, Bode, model history, quantities
Explicit selectionAn event is chosen, never "latest"; the address carries ?event= and ?tab=
Censored candidatesCounted, listed on request
Model reviewSame dialog, same permission, same revision check
Open in Evidence WorkbenchThe band's Workbench ↗ (the event's G12 run)
